theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rh_edc_euler_dilate
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → (∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ y, ((n : ℝ) * g y + fderiv ℝ g y y) ∂μ = 0) → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → (n : ℝ) * (∫ y, g (t⁻¹ • y) ∂μ) + ∫ y, fderiv ℝ g (t⁻¹ • y) (t⁻¹ • y) ∂μ = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
